content: BERT-PN is used to verify the feasibility of PSP. The comparison with BERT-PN5cls illustrates whether more document-level information helps. BERT-PNsmth, which is the label-smoothed version of BERT-PN5cls, is used to compare with BERT-PN5cls to see whether the noise reduction is necessary.
qasper_evidence_text: BERT-PN is used to verify the feasibility of PSP. The comparison with BERT-PN5cls illustrates whether more document-level information helps. BERT-PNsmth, which is the label-smoothed version of BERT-PN5cls, is used to compare with BERT-PN5cls to see whether the noise reduction is necessary.
